2 years ago they won 52 games with the 7th best netrtg in the league (4.6). As you mentioned were called an up and coming team before losing in the first round of the playoffs to a vet heavy GS team. Last year they won 52 games with the 6th best netrtg in the league (5.4) before losing in the first round of the playoffs despite missing multiple key contributors (some of whom are overrated, but key nonetheless). I think the truth is they probably werent all that "up n coming" two years ago, and the vibes weren't as bad as people think they were last year. They are a good team that I dont think is as good as Thunder or the Spurs but I can talk myself into seeing them finish anywhere from 3rd to 6 in the same cohort they were in last year (Lakers, Denver, Minny).
